D: A blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate captain to rescue a governor's daughter from a cursed crew.
P: Serve the drinks when Jack and Elizabeth are marooned on the island.
S: the apple Barbossa has waited years to taste
Crisp green apple slices tossed in lime juice, served with a salted caramel dip of melted caramels and cream, and shards of sharp cheddar on the side.

Chopped prawns in a spiced batter with capsicum, onion and chilli, fried into crisp golden fritters, with a lime and hot sauce mayo. Roughly chop 400g raw peeled prawns. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 150ml milk, half a teaspoon of allspice and salt. Fold in the prawns, half a diced red capsicum, 3 sliced spring onions, 1 chopped red chilli and thyme leaves. Drop spoonfuls into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes until golden. Mix 120g mayonnaise with lime zest and juice and 1 tsp hot sauce to dip.
Plantain slices fried twice until golden and crisp, salted, brushed with a little edible gold lustre on the top ones.
M: Chicken marylands marinated overnight in scotch bonnet, allspice, thyme, spring onion, garlic and lime, grilled slowly over coals until charred. Rice and peas.
the British fort at Port Royal

Snapper simmered gently in coconut milk with tomato, capsicum, thyme, allspice and a whole chilli, with rice and peas and fried plantain. Cook 300g rice with 1 drained tin kidney beans, 270ml coconut milk, 300ml water and thyme for 18 minutes. Soften 1 onion, 1 capsicum and 3 garlic cloves in oil, add half a teaspoon of allspice, 2 diced tomatoes, 400ml coconut milk and 1 whole scotch bonnet and simmer 10 minutes. Add 800g snapper chunks and poach 6 minutes. Fry 2 sliced ripe plantains in oil until golden. Finish the stew with lime and serve.
W: the governor's town before the attack
Buttery little shortcrust tarts filled with cooked pineapple jam. Cook 1 grated pineapple with 150g sugar and a cinnamon stick for 40 minutes until thick.
K: the stash buried on the island
Dark rum, lime, sugar syrup, pineapple and orange juice over ice with nutmeg.

s.note: the apple Barbossa has waited years to taste
s.how: Slice 3 green apples and toss in lime juice. Melt 200g caramels with 3 tbsp cream and a pinch of flaky salt. Serve the apples with the warm dip and shards of 150g sharp cheddar.
Peel 3 green plantains and slice into thick coins. Fry at 160C for 3 minutes, smash flat, then fry at 190C until golden and crisp. Salt and brush the top ones with edible gold lustre.

m.how: Blitz 2 scotch bonnets, 2 tsp allspice, thyme, 4 spring onions, 3 garlic cloves and lime juice. Marinate 4 chicken marylands overnight and grill slowly over coals until charred. Cook 300g rice with a tin of kidney beans and coconut milk.

w.note: the governor's town before the attack
w.how: Cook 1 grated pineapple with 150g sugar and a cinnamon stick for 40 minutes until thick. Fill 18 small shortcrust cases and bake at 180C for 18 minutes.

d.note: the stash buried on the island
d.how: Mix the juice of 3 limes, 60ml sugar syrup, 180ml dark rum, 300ml pineapple juice and 300ml orange juice. Pour over ice and grate nutmeg on top. Why is the rum always gone?
